column3: types.ts:9 imports SceneNode from scene/scene-node.js, but the interface also adds lightType (18), shadowGenerator (29), _bumpLightVersion (39) and _validateLighting (41), so it is not just SceneNode plus UBO writer, version counter and mesh filters

math/observable-vec3.ts:8 is the only class; light-base.ts:9, math/index.ts:53, index.ts:1009 re-export it; spot/directional/hemispheric use it for direction (spot-light.ts:42), interfaces type position as ObservableVec3 (point-light.ts:11)

_writeLightUbo gets the entry offset (scene-lights-ubo.ts:51 headerFloats + count*LIGHT_ENTRY_FLOATS); tags point 0, directional 1, spot 2, hemispheric 3, rectArea 4; multilight-wgsl.ts:26-37 branches on u32(vLightData.w)

eight material files read u32(...vLightData.w) inside WGSL strings (e.g. multilight-wgsl.ts:26, standard-template.ts:40, _lighting-helper.ts:42); light/types.ts:5 doc comment says the type is encoded in vLightData.w
defined at light/types.ts:63; used by fillLightsData in render/scene-lights-ubo.ts:51 and applyLightFoOffset in large-world/floating-origin.ts:113
scene-core.ts:541 (addToScene branch, after the _gpu/material mesh test) pushes to ctx.lights on "lightType" in entity; scene-remove.ts:79 splices it out on the same test; no class or registry check

the list is not all of them: src/light/enable-rect-area-lights.ts:30, process-area-light-texture.ts:25 and area-light-emission.ts:39-46 also walk scene.lights skipping lights without _writeLightUbo to count packed index, and they are not light factories
scene-lights-ubo.ts:45, mesh-light-selection.ts:31, floating-origin.ts:107 and rect-area-light-fragment.ts:22 break at the cap; nothing logs or throws (no warn/throw anywhere near MAX_LIGHTS in src)

template literal substitutions of MAX_LIGHTS run at module evaluation (wgsl tag, shader/wgsl.ts:11, gets values eagerly); setMaxLights (types.ts:56-60) only reassigns the live binding, so these consts keep the old value

only call is gltf-feature-lights-punctual.ts:64, guarded by lightNodeCount > MAX_LIGHTS (63) so it only raises; runs in applyAsset before addToScene compiles pipelines (comment 53-56); MAX_LIGHTS is assigned only in types.ts:59

size is recomputed per call (scene-lights-ubo.ts:23), but the buffer is not rebuilt only on size change: recovery-rebuild.ts:98-99 clears scene._lightGpuState and ensureSceneLightState then builds a new one (line 159), and it is also created the first time
output shows light-base.ts:49 returning lvs._lightVersion + node.worldMatrixVersion and the glTF getter returning baseGet.call(light) + extra

gltf-feature-lights-punctual.ts:26-28 does not compare versions, it reads the descriptor and redefines the getter; only scene-lights-ubo.ts and the four shadow files read versions to decide on re-uploads/re-renders

spot-light.ts:89 angle; rect-area-light.ts:85-97 width/height/intensity, 99-121 diffuse/specular (with Proxy), 124 emissionTexture; light-base.ts:47 _lightVersion; point/spot intensity, diffuse, specular are plain fields (point-light.ts:30-33, spot-light.ts:45-48)

set-light-intensity.ts:12 and set-light-diffuse-color.ts:14 (both exported in index.ts:272-273) bump after direct writes; animation-pointer-lights.ts:56 bumps after writing diffuse/intensity/range/angle (40-54)

hemispheric.ts:11-13 uses diffuseColor/specularColor/groundColor while point/spot/directional/rect-area use diffuse; setLightDiffuseColor is typed LightBase & { diffuse: [...] } (set-light-diffuse-color.ts:4)

light-clone.ts:13 defines it; transform-node.ts:46 cloneTransformNode passes it to src._cloneNode; scene-node.ts:59 types the hook; light-clone.ts:1-6 says it is kept out of light-base.ts so only scenes that clone ship it
each of point-light.ts:34, spot-light.ts:49, directional-light.ts:32, hemispheric.ts:29, rect-area-light.ts:53 calls its own create* factory and copies its kind-specific fields by hand, then copyBase

types.ts:31-34 and scene-lights-ubo.ts:36-39 say writers emit raw world positions; scene-lights-ubo.ts:88/120/137 call engine._applyLightFoOffset after fillLightsData; engine.ts:457-466 wires it to floating-origin.ts:96 which subtracts the camera offset

render/mesh-light-selection.ts:14 applies includedOnlyMeshes, but load-babylon.ts matches only on the JSON key includedOnlyMeshesIds (129, 361) and fills the ID sets excludedMeshIds/includedOnlyMeshIds (363, 366), not the mesh sets

createRectAreaLight does not throw when the light is built; rect-area-light.ts:50 throws from _validateLighting at scene build (scene-core.ts:660), and area-light-ltc.ts:185 throws when binding LTC tables at render

scene-core.ts:659-661 buildScene calls light._validateLighting?.(scene._lighting) for every light; rect-area-light.ts:49-50 throws there when scene._lighting has no _single("rectArea"), which is set only at enable-rect-area-lights.ts:68

area-light-ltc.ts:9 fixed LTC_URL on assets.babylonjs.com; fetch at 51 inside loadPixels, reached through prepareAreaLightLtc (141) from enableRectAreaLights (enable-rect-area-lights.ts:38,40); no other fetch in src/light

rect-area-light.ts:46-47 throws on shadowGenerator in _validateLighting at buildScene; enable-rect-area-lights.ts:56-58 _validateNode throws when a lights-using node material builds (node-renderable.ts:103) with a rect-area light present

only call is process-area-light-texture.ts:120 at the end of processAreaLightTexture; enable-rect-area-lights.ts:27-31 throws if a packed rect-area light has an emissionTexture while prepareEmission is still unset

area-light-image.ts:42-43 throws when the texture has no matching _areaLightImage (only set by process-area-light-texture.ts:117); enable-rect-area-lights.ts:27-31 throws when no texture was ever preprocessed

output lists the type-position import("../shadow/shadow-generator.js") in types.ts:29, the emission-setup import in process-area-light-texture.ts:28, and the PBR and Standard rect-area fragment imports in enable-rect-area-lights.ts:36-37
one of the six files, light/enable-rect-area-lights.ts (current._lighting?._prepare at 46, 48), is not material code; it is the enable step itself installing Standard scene hooks

enable-rect-area-lights.ts:43 and area-light-emission-setup.ts:25 call _registerStdExt, both rect-area; clustered.ts:196 and clustered-spot-support.ts:50 call only _registerPbrExt and import nothing from material/standard

clustered.ts:21-30 has only position/diffuse/range/intensity, with no lightType and no SceneNode fields; created as an object literal at 139-144 and pushed to container.pointLights; addToScene only adds to lights when "lightType" in entity (scene-core.ts:541)
clustered.ts:200-205 in addClusteredLightContainer loops once over ctx.meshes and sets mat._clusteredLightState; no other assignment of _clusteredLightState in src
clustered.ts:362-363 throws in refresh when liveCount exceeds the texels/batches sized at build (293-302) or spot support changed; build runs from addClusteredLightContainer (197)
buildClusteredLightGpuState (clustered.ts:276-278) throws when scene.camera is missing; its only caller is addClusteredLightContainer (197)

the three ++ sites are right, but in-place edits are seen without the dirty call: a camera, size or aspect change sets topologyDirty (365-371), which rebuilds activeLights and rewrites light data from current light fields (395-447)
clustered.ts:198 installs it in addClusteredLightContainer; scene-core.ts:294 declares it; render-task-base.ts:502 calls it in prepareRenderTaskPass for colour passes, each frame
only call is clustered.ts:165 in createClusteredSpotLight; _spotSupport is set only at clustered-spot-support.ts:49; without it lightStride stays 2 (clustered.ts:296)
